claims.text: The schema requires ok (const false) and code, and forbids unknown properties via additionalProperties false.

The code enum fixes exactly twenty codes: bad_args, bad_op, stale_rev, busy, internal, conflict, no_agent, no_run, run_closed, memory_required, memory_debt, forbidden_level, not_inheritable, hash_mismatch, rule_not_declared, no_benchmark, heldout_forbidden, seat_not_allowed, fixture_readonly and timeout.
The optional detail string is bounded to minLength 1 and maxLength 2048 characters.

decision.rule: Change here when the tool error wire shape, fixed error codes, or detail bound needs to change.
decision.failure: A tool error uses a code outside the enum, carries an extra property, or omits ok or code.

questions.q: Where does the tool_error schema fix the twenty allowed error codes?
Where should I change the detail length bound on tool errors?
Where can I debug why a tool error is rejected for a missing code?
